lines: Je Rabb milda nhaateyan dhoteyan
couplets.en: If bathing and washing could bring us to God.

lines: Je Maula milda
couplets.en: If only one could find the Lord.

lines: Je Rabb milda nhaateyan dhoteyan
couplets.en: If bathing and washing could bring us to God.

lines: Te Rabb milda dadduan machhian nu
couplets.en: Then the frogs and fish would find him.

lines: Je Rabb milda jangal phiriyan
couplets.en: If wandering the woods could bring us to God.

lines: Te Rabb milda gaavan vachhiyan nu
couplets.en: Then the cows and calves would find him.

lines: Ve miyan Bulleya, Rabb ohnan nu milda
couplets.en: Dear Bulleya, it is to such people that God comes.

lines: Te milda dilan sachiyan achhiyan nu
couplets.en: He comes to hearts that are true and kind.

lines: Tasbih bahuti pher na, Bahu
couplets.en: Bahu, spare yourself the endless turning of beads.

lines: Tasbih bahuti pher na, Bahu
couplets.en: Bahu, spare yourself the endless turning of beads.

lines: Is tasbih da ki parhna, Hu
couplets.en: What is there to gain from telling these beads?

lines: Oh jihra apne naal hisaab nahin karda
couplets.en: Some people never reckon with themselves.

lines: Ohde naal hisaab ki karna
couplets.en: What account can you settle with them?

lines: Ik nuqte vich gall mukdi ae
couplets.en: It all comes down to a single point.

lines: Phar nuqta, chhor hisaaban nu
couplets.en: Grasp the point and leave your reckonings behind.

lines: Ik nuqte vich gall mukdi ae

lines: Parh nuqta, chhor hisaaban nu

lines: Ohda Rabb vi nahin russda, Rabb di saun
couplets.en: I swear by God, even God takes no offense with such a soul.

lines: Jihnu yaar manaun da chajj hove
couplets.en: They know how to win the beloved's heart again.

lines: Ohnu Makke jaan di lor nahin
couplets.en: For such a soul, there is no need to go to Mecca.

lines: Jihnu yaar de vekhyan hajj hove
couplets.en: The sight of the beloved is pilgrimage enough.

lines: Phar nuqta, chhor hisaaban nu
couplets.en: Grasp the point and leave your reckonings behind.

lines: Chhadd dozakh, gor, azaaban nu
couplets.en: Leave behind hell, the grave, and their torments.

lines: Kar band kufr diyan baaban nu
couplets.en: Shut the doors on unbelief.

lines: Kar saaf dil deyan khwaaban nu
couplets.en: Clear the dreams that cloud the heart.

lines: Gall aise ghar vich dhukdi ae
couplets.en: The truth finds its way into such a house.

lines: Parh parh ilm hazaar kitaaban
couplets.en: You have read your way through a thousand books.

lines: Kadi apne aap nu parhiya nahin
couplets.en: You have yet to read yourself.

lines: Ja ja varde mandar maseeti
couplets.en: You keep entering temples and mosques.

lines: Kadi man apne vich variya nahin
couplets.en: You have yet to step inside your own heart.

lines: Aiven larda shaitaan de naal, bandeya
couplets.en: You wear yourself out fighting the devil.

lines: Kadi nafs apne naal lariya nahin
couplets.en: You have yet to wrestle with your own desires.

lines: Aiven larda ae shaitaan de naal, bandeya
couplets.en: You wear yourself out fighting the devil.

lines: Kadi nafs apne naal lariya nahin
couplets.en: You have yet to wrestle with your own desires.

lines: Aakhe Pir Bulleh Shah, asmaani pharna ae
couplets.en: Pir Bulleh Shah says you reach for the One in the heavens.

lines: Jihra man vich vasda, ohnu phariya nahin
couplets.en: You have yet to find the One who lives in your heart.

lines: Aiven mattha zameen ghisaida
couplets.en: You wear your forehead against the ground in vain.

lines: Pa lamma mehrab dikhaida
couplets.en: You show off the mark of prayer on your brow.

lines: Masjid dha de, mandar dha de
couplets.en: Pull down the mosque and the temple.

lines: Dha de jo kujh dhainda
couplets.en: Pull down whatever can be pulled down.

lines: Par kise da dil na dhaveen
couplets.en: Spare the heart of another.

lines: Rabb dilan vich rehnda
couplets.en: God lives in hearts.

lines: Aashiq hoiyo Rabb da, hoi malaamat lakh
couplets.en: Love God and a hundred thousand voices will reproach you.

lines: Tainu kaafir kaafir aakhde, tu aaho aaho aakh, ho miyan
couplets.en: When they call you faithless, tell them yes.

lines: Kai haaji ban ban aaye ji
couplets.en: Many came decked out as pilgrims.

lines: Gal neele jaame paaye ji
couplets.en: They wore blue robes.

lines: Dushman mare taan khushi na kariye
couplets.en: Take no joy in an enemy's death.

lines: Sajjan vi mar jaana ae
couplets.en: Those we love must die as well.

lines: Degar te din gaya, Muhammad
couplets.en: The day is spent by late afternoon, Muhammad.

lines: Orak nu dubb jaana ae
couplets.en: In the end the sun must set.

lines: Uth Farida sutteya, duniya vekhan ja
couplets.en: Wake, Farid, and go out to see the world.

lines: Je koi mil jaaye bakhshiya, te tu vi bakhshiya jaaye
couplets.en: Meet someone who has been forgiven and you too may find pardon.

lines: Hajj vech takke lai khaaye ji
couplets.en: They sold their pilgrimage and lived on the coins.

lines: Par eh gall kihnu bhaaye ji
couplets.en: But who would care to hear that?
